integrity: A standard-library reproducibility program and complete mathematical exposition accompany this result; file byte counts and SHA-256 digests are verifiable.
scientific_limitations: Binary weight two only; forbidden prefix-suffix lengths n-2 and n-1; finite tests do not prove the infinite claim, which is established by orbit bounds and construction. Equivalences in unindexed literature may remain; external independent validation not performed.
title: Exact weight-two capacity under the two longest forbidden overlaps
